headline: Stray Kids' 'Christmas EveL' MV tops 200M views
sub: Their 10th music video to pass 200 million on YouTube
source: Source: JYP Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
Stray Kids' holiday hit 'Christmas EveL' has crossed 200 million views on YouTube.

The music video passed the mark on Nov 20 at 5:17 PM KST, just in time for the holiday season. It's the group's 10th music video to reach 200 million views.

📌 Source: JYP Entertainment (via Korean media)
